properties.overall_description: The Will Rogers Memorial Center is a historic and expansive 120-acre multipurpose venue located in the heart of Fort Worth's Cultural District. Since its opening in 1938, it has served as a cornerstone for the community, hosting a diverse range of activities from prestigious equestrian and agricultural shows to intimate concerts and national tours. With its unique blend of traditional architecture and modern climate-controlled facilities, the center attracts millions of visitors who appreciate both its functional versatility and its deep historical roots.

properties.amenities_description: The facility provides comprehensive event infrastructure including multiple climate-controlled arenas, extensive exhibit halls, and various food service options. Guests can navigate the grounds using elevators, escalators, and a system of underground tunnels.
properties.unique_selling_points: As a historic 120-acre venue established in 1938, this iconic center is uniquely positioned as a premier destination for both major equestrian and agricultural competitions as well as intimate live concerts. Its blend of classic architecture and state-of-the-art climate-controlled facilities makes it a landmark gathering place in the region.
